dedupeText: retro western romance soundtrack layout 1970s aesthetic slab serif circular inset portrait warm sunlight plaid shirt western romance heavy typography red text the red title block anchors the top left creating a diagonal tension with the circular inset on the top right the warm golden backlight on the hair of the subjects creates a soft halo effect against the natural background the intimate profile of the couple occupies the lower two thirds of the frame providing a solid base for the graphic elements above combine 1970s warm romantic photography heavy red slab serif title block circular inset portrait to create a retro soundtrack aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style layout featuring a warm, sun-drenched romantic close-up with heavy red slab-serif typography and a circular inset portrait.

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, sun-lit outdoor scene of a couple in a close, intimate profile view, characterized by golden-hour lighting, 1970s fashion (plaid and leather), and a dominant red slab-serif title block in the upper left, balanced by a circular portrait inset in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: The red title block anchors the top-left, creating a diagonal tension with the circular inset on the top-right.
The warm, golden backlight on the hair of the subjects creates a soft halo effect against the natural background.
The intimate profile of the couple occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, providing a solid base for the graphic elements above.
coreInvariants: Circular inset portrait with a red border
Outdoor natural setting with soft-focus foliage

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects in profile, facing each other, occupying the center and lower half of the frame at a medium-close scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold red title text in the upper left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red title, moves across to the circular inset, then down to the faces of the central couple.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is relatively open to accommodate the primary typography and inset.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones (browns, tans, greens) from the natural environment and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant tomato red used for all primary typographic and graphic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow highlights from backlit hair and sunlight.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, low-contrast values in the photography contrasted against high-saturation, high-value red graphics.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to warm, organic tones plus one primary red

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with thick blocky serifs and uniform stroke weight.
letterConstructionRules: Solid red fill with no outlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' and 'L' have very short, blocky horizontal strokes.
The 'R' has a sturdy, straight leg.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales of the same slab-serif family for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Circular inset frame with a thin red border
Staggered text alignment to create a dynamic block

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif weight and blocky terminals.
Provides the classic 70s editorial slab-serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm, sun-drenched 1970s film-style photograph of a man in a plaid shirt and a woman in a leather jacket in a close romantic profile outdoors. Leave the top third of the frame clear for text, with a circular inset area in the top right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold red slab-serif title in the top left. Add a secondary smaller red slab-serif text block below it. Place a circular portrait with a thin red border in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the red color vibrant and consistent?
Is the typography a heavy slab serif?
Is the lighting warm and backlit?
Is the circular inset present in the top right?

mustRedesign: Do not use modern digital filters; maintain 70s film grain.
Do not use thin or elegant fonts.
Avoid cool or blue-toned color palettes.
postGenerationChecks: Verify the text is solid red without gradients.
Ensure the circular inset has a distinct red border.
Check that the subjects' hair has a golden highlight from backlighting.
Confirm the slab-serif font is sufficiently heavy and blocky.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [1970s warm romantic photography] + [Heavy red slab-serif title block] + [Circular inset portrait] to create a [Retro Soundtrack Aesthetic].
